shared_elements: bearded figures with long patterned hair/headdress
figures with raised arms holding objects
horizontal border band framing the scene (inscription band / rosette band)
patterned garment folds rendered as repeated parallel lines
justification: Both surfaces show shallow-relief human figures in strict profile with elaborately curled beards/hair and finely striated drapery, arranged in a single horizontal register bounded by a decorative/inscribed band, and both include stylised floral rosette forms. However, A is a symmetrical heraldic composition of winged attendants flanking a stylised sacred tree, while B is a one-directional procession of men leading a camel, so the relationships between figures (mirrored flanking versus linear leading) and the presence of a large animal differ substantially.
